subject.zh: 悬浮的黑绿多层电路甲板

description.en: A floating thick square deck shares Dotty’s elevated camera and whole-object safety inset. Dense circuitry fills the top and stacked sidewalls while preserving one clear solid block.
description.zh: 悬浮的厚方形甲板延续 Dotty 的斜上方镜头与整体安全留白。密集电路铺满表面及层叠侧壁，仍保持一个清楚、完整的材质主体。

title.zh: 黑色结构与绿色带电走线

description.en: Near-black panels, metallic contacts and many thin circuit layers read as a physical engineered material. One small arc bridges deck contacts; the separate subtle lower spill adds light only to large presentations.
description.zh: 近黑面板、金属触点与多层细电路组成拟物工程材质。小电弧连接表面触点，下缘微弱外发光单独处理，仅用于大尺寸展示。

description.en: Pale mint engineering paper combines fine cells with larger backplane divisions, stepped routes and terminal vias. The geometry differs from Dotty’s drafting marks and Basalt’s architectural elevations.
description.zh: 浅薄荷色工程纸结合细格、较大的背板分区、折线走线和端点过孔，纹理几何与 Dotty 的制图标记、Basalt 的建筑立面各不相同。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px the deck shape, green routing and layered rim remain readable. At 32/24/16 px the transparent mark resolves to a dark diamond-like block with a green circuit signature; individual vias and the small arc merge into that accent.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能读出甲板形状、绿色走线和层叠侧缘；32/24/16 px 透明标记凝练为带绿色电路特征的深色菱形方块，独立过孔与小电弧合并为色彩点缀。

goal.en: Reuse terminal-inspired controls, charts, and page templates to build green-on-black data dashboards.
goal.zh: 复用终端风格的控件、图表和页面模板，搭建绿黑配色的数据看板。

role.zh: 看板页面与可复用控件

description.en: Small grid cells meet stepped routes and terminal vias, echoing the layers of the circuit deck.
description.zh: 小网格、阶梯走线与端点过孔相接，呼应电路甲板层层展开的结构。

alt.en: Floating black-and-green layered circuit deck on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 悬浮的黑绿多层电路甲板，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.zh: 悬浮的黑绿多层电路甲板。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥78px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 78px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
